executable.title: Spot Annotation
executable.description: Generate Visium spot annotations from either spot centroid coordinates and cell composition (omics) files, or from integrated 10x Visium data.
executable.acknowledgements: This work is part of efforts in digital pathology by the Sarder Lab: UFL.

image.name: input_file
image.label: Input Image
image.description: Input image file containing integrated 10x Visium data or omics analysis results.

file.name: cell_reference_file
file.label: Cell Reference File
file.description: CSV file mapping cell types, cell subtypes, and cell states.

file.name: gene_list_file
file.label: Gene List File
file.description: Optional CSV file with a single column containing specific gene identifiers to include in the analysis.

file.name: scale_factors
file.label: Scale Factors File
file.description: Optional JSON file containing scaling factors to convert between image resolutions (high resolution and low resolution to full resolution).

file.name: spot_coords
file.label: Spot Coordinates File
file.description: Optional CSV file containing spatial coordinates for Visium spots. If not provided, coordinates will be extracted from the input image.

parameters.label: Girder API URL and Key
parameters.description: A Girder API URL and token for Girder client
